answers.core: This is part of the editor, so I believe it should be core.
answers.workaround: This can be edited of course by people in their own forks, but this is clearly not ideal. Quick load is really useful as far as I am concerned, but I think the choice between quick and slow load should not be imposed on the user in that way.

title: Allowing customization of which load menu is used in `EditorResourcePicker`
